A lot of it has to do with because people don't think you have something to bring to the conversation. Meaning, if I act a certain way and I do a certain thing, what are these people going to think?  Being able to "know" how people will react rather than just guess or try to think how they will is the highest quality to have that will help you succeed in socialisms  more.  It allows flexibility, the ability to discern people's different personalities and how to react to each one appropriately.  It will allow you to more quickly catch the social ques because you can discern what others might be thinking.  Some of this comes from experience, but much of it just comes from self-awareness.
